tools.name: search_optical_knowledge
tools.description: Search public optical education in Portuguese or English. Returns source excerpts, not medical advice or customer records.

tools.name: get_optical_topic
tools.description: Read a public optical topic by stable ID with references, related topics and limitations.

tools.name: transpose_prescription
tools.description: Transpose sphere/cylinder notation without changing the prescription. Dioptres and degrees; axis 0–180. Does not diagnose or generate prescriptions.

tools.name: calculate_decentration
tools.description: Symmetric boxing frame only: (A + bridge)/2 minus monocular PD, per eye, in mm. Positive nasal; negative temporal. No vertical or prescribed prism compensation.

tools.name: calculate_prism
tools.description: Educational Prentice approximation: absolute meridional power times displacement in cm. Returns magnitude only, no base direction or prescription recommendation.
